game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow, a scarab burrow: the caravan guide must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Syntax Sweep: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scarab Burrow: a scarab burrow
core_gameplay_loop: In Scarab Burrow, repeat each round: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the syntax_errors value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the palm grove using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The palm grove reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the palm grove is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Syntax Sweep
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Syntax Sweep' (Week 9 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Scarab Burrow'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how syntax_errors changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against desert bandits in Scarab Burrow.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The palm grove reached with actions_used <= 21.
